summary: A list whose items can hold more items, which the user opens and closes. It is one stop in the Tab order.

value.description: The value of the selected item.

root.note: Stacks its items. It paints nothing.

keys.ArrowDown, ArrowUp: Move focus to the next or the previous item that shows, without wrapping.
keys.ArrowRight: On a closed item: open it. On an open one: move focus to its first child. ArrowLeft in a right-to-left scope.
keys.ArrowLeft: On an open item: close it. Otherwise: move focus to its parent. ArrowRight in a right-to-left scope.
keys.Home, End: Move focus to the first or the last item that shows.
keys.A letter: Moves focus to the next item that shows and starts with it.

events.change: Dispatched after the user selects another item.

guidance.text: The author names the tree with aria-label or aria-labelledby.

notYet: Loading children when an item opens.
